services.value: The Diagnostic Serology Team performs serological screening and testing for a large variety of infectious diseases, including screening for Hepatitis B, Rubella (German Measles), and syphilis, and confirming disease outbreaks such as measles. It also tests for less commonly encountered diseases such as Hantavirus and arboviral encephalitis, using specimens including serum, and in some cases plasma and Cerebral Spinal Fluid (CSF).
